notes.title: Px2d v2.5 update log
notes.content:
1. Added a separate standard avatar template
2. Added an 8-in-1 avatar template. There are 8 expressions, including normal expression, smile, anger, shyness, surprise, crying, dizziness, and speechless expression.
3. Fixed some bugs
4. Adjusted the material interface selection method, left clicking with the mouse will no longer automatically redirect to the main interface, and you need to press the 1 key again to return to the main interface.
5. Optimized the battle chart template of RPGMaker and adapted it to long weapon types.

notes.title: Px2d v2.4 update log
notes.content:
1. The download Mod button on the main interface has been removed.
After clicking on the selected component, a secondary panel was added.
3. The x-coordinate, y-coordinate, rotation, scaling, display hierarchy, and other attributes of the component are displayed on the secondary panel.
4. Display the sprite image of the component on the secondary panel. Right click to select the sprite image.
5. Added color adjustment function on the secondary panel. You can adjust the brightness, saturation, and hue of the component.
6. Added a button to display the material list on the main interface. Click the left mouse button to display and close the material list.
7. Adjusted the loading of images. Just name the pictures by their numbers. The Px2d.ini configuration file has been deleted. There is no need to modify the Px2d.ini file anymore.
8. Added the DefRes default resource folder in the root directory of the tool, where all resources used by default in the tool will be placed.
9. Added an external action library in the root directory.
10. Modified the method of saving files, previously loading materials according to sprites. Now modify to load materials according to the saved image path.

notes.title: Px2dV2.3 update log
notes.content:
1. The main interface has been adjusted. The 7 pre made action buttons in the bottom left corner have been removed. And the prompt button in the upper left corner.

2. Added RM templates to the resource library. A unarmed walking diagram template. A sword shield walking diagram template. A sword shield battle diagram template.

3. Added the multi in one template in the resource database. One sword and shield can be combined into one template. And 9 horizontal plates.
